actions.text: Did you hear that? It sounded like a choir of bells! A very loud, very angry choir!
It's just the wiring, Ellis. Old building. Very old. Probably just settling into the earth.

beats.narrative_purpose: Hook: The elevator dings and the lights flicker aggressively.

actions.text: Superintendent Mara! I'm here for the quarterly audit. This hallway is a mess.
Why is the hallway light blinking in Morse code? Is the building trying to talk to me?
It's a feature! Energy saving! It's very modern, really. Don't mind the rhythm.

beats.narrative_purpose: Voss enters to inspect the hallway.

actions.text: The elevator is opening! But there's nothing there! Just purple fog and the smell of ozone!
Purple fog is not on the approved building materials list. This is highly irregular.

beats.narrative_purpose: Ellis tries to investigate the elevator.

actions.text: It's just... localized humidity. Very high, very purple humidity. It's a tropical microclimate!
Humidity doesn't hum 'The Star-Spangled Banner' at forty decibels. Explain that, Mara.

beats.narrative_purpose: Mara attempts to deflect the inspector.

actions.text: It's pulling in a vacuum! My hair is standing up! Help!
Voss, please! Stop writing! I have a quota to meet and a reality to maintain!
Violation: Unsanctioned spatial rift and unauthorized musical humidity.

beats.narrative_purpose: Escalation: The elevator makes a loud noise.

actions.text: I'm seeing a floor labeled 'The Void'. This is a major citation. A massive one!
Ooh, looks cozy! Very minimalist! I might move in!
I'm really not getting overtime for fixing the fabric of space-time.

beats.narrative_purpose: Climax/Cliffhanger: The elevator doors open wide.

central_goal.goal: complete the shift without revealing anomalies

episode_title: The Inspector and the Impossible Ding
logline: Voss tries to document a code violation while Ellis and Mara struggle to hide the elevator's tendency to visit non-existent floors.
payoff: Voss begins writing a massive fine as the elevator begins to suck the hallway into a different dimension.
